name: Nigerian Barbecued Chicken Wings
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Combine the flour, cornmeal, pepper, salt, sugar, ginger, and paprika in a bowl.
Add the chicken pieces, and rub the mixture into them well so they are completely coated.
Set in the fridge, and allow the chicken to rest for 1 hour.
Arrange the chicken pieces on a baking tray or on a grill. Grill or bake until cooked through (about 45 minutes baking at 375°F).

culture.text: Nigerian barbecued chicken wings are usually eaten as a side dish or served alongside grains like jollof rice and fried rice. They are especially common at parties, gatherings and festivals.
